## 定级(skills 车道自分诊):`Task` · `tooling` · `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`

p1 依据(已实现伤害,非理论):46%(24/52)在飞卡的交付已合并未回标、14 张滞留 4.6–6.0 天全部落在 H8 约 24h 窗口之外 —— 且 #11925 案例证明这类残留会**伪装成活的独占写者**,压住 #12104/#12034/#12181 三张卡 5 天不派。仪表失明直接损耗派发吞吐。路由:H8 属 `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`(比照 check-governed-merges 归 skills 的先例)。

派发范围采卡的建议形并落死三件套:① 条数帽改**时间帽**(翻页至 `merged_at` 早于 N 天,N 从最长实测未执行判定延迟推导,保留页数上限作配额兜底);② 注释里的 `~18 merges/day` 换成推导量或**过期即响**的自检;③ 双向自测(窗口内命中报 + 旧判据看不见而新判据应在内的也报)。相邻 #11036(Refs 拼法盲区)⛔ 不并本卡(其面是 H8 的判定逻辑非窗口;两缺陷叠加的事实随卡引用)。

**折叠候选:与 #13493 · #13526 同文件(`check-half-states.mjs`)三卡折叠**,下一空位按五门判——三卡合一 PR 只过一次治理合并。

Claim: os-dev seat — THREE-CARD FOLD implementation start (#13499 anchor · #13493 half-① · #13526 legs ①②)
Session: `session_01EXxTW8mvPBhoHxmyPZ63de` (dev subagent dispatched by the skills-lane PM, loop round 4)
Branch: `claude/issue-13499-half-states-patrol`
Worktree: `../objectstack-issue-13499`
File surface: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` ONLY — pure code. No `.md` enters the diff (that would flip the PR onto the maintainer-approval lane and defeat the fold). Stop-and-report on any breach.

Per-card plan:

**#13499 (p1) — H8 merged-PR window.** ① `listRecentlyMergedPullRequests` COUNT cap becomes a TIME cap: paginate until `merged_at` is older than N days, N derived from the longest measured unexecuted-verdict latency (the 4.6–6.0-day stranding is the floor evidence), with a page ceiling retained purely as a quota backstop. ② The `~18 merges/day` comment premise becomes a derived quantity plus an expiry alarm that goes loud when the premise is stale — a hard-coded rate in a comment is the root cause. ③ H8 self-tests in BOTH directions: an in-window hit reported, AND a delivery outside the old count-window but inside the new time-window reported. Survey-only (no fix) on the three sibling 10-page windows at `:3980` / `:4066` / `:4105` — findings go in the report. Adjacent #11036 (Refs-spelling blindness) is NOT touched: H8's delivery-recognition logic stays as-is.

**#13493 — seat-post staleness leg, half-① only.** New report-only patrol leg. `T_seat` = the `pm:seat` post's last event (body edit time or newest comment time, whichever is later); scan that seat's lane (`domain:*` for domain seats, `repo:*` for single-lane seats, as the post names) for `pm:dispatched` cards; take the newest comment whose FIRST LINE begins with the literal `Claim:`; claim newer than `T_seat` ⇒ report the seat post stale. The `Claim:` literal first-line predicate is reused strictly and not widened. `labels` filters are OR not AND ⇒ filter by ONE label and intersect locally. Report-only: writes nothing, blocks nothing. Half-② (the 收班中 marker) is a protocol change and stays OUT, per the card's own boundary.

**#13526 — runnability + census legs.** ① Diagnose the prerequisite that is actually missing in an agent container and degrade gracefully to the legs that CAN run rather than exiting 3, so a container gets a real reading; the sentence "a gate nobody can run is indistinguishable from a gate that finds nothing" goes into the gate's own refusal output. ② New census leg: closed issues still carrying `pm:*` state labels, per lane per label, FULLY PAGINATED — a page cap is never reported as a count, and the control query (same shape without the pm label) must return rows — plus the contradictory-pair listing (`pm:queue`+`pm:dispatched` both present). Pull requests are filtered out (the `issues` endpoint returns both). No bulk relabel of closed cards rides this PR: census only, cleanup is its own decision card.

Verification: the script's own self-test green at the final commit with the new cases added (both-direction H8, staleness fixtures, census page-cap-is-not-a-count assertion); gates derived from the actual diff; one ablation per repair leg with hash-proven restore; one read-only live-fire of the patrol against the real repo, with real paginated counts in the report.

Delivery lane: NON-GOVERNED (pure code). PR opens as DRAFT and stays draft — I never flip ready, never enqueue, never arm auto-merge.

## Contract review PASS — direct landing arming (non-governed pure code)

Reviewed at head `9086f3ba9` (the origin/main merge included — the #13574 duplicate-drop is visible in the diff shape: one file, +1009/−46, zero `.md`). Verified independently, not from the report:

- Self-test run by this seat at the PR head: `✓ check-half-states self-test: 1685 cases pass.`
- `MERGED_WINDOW_PAGES` deleted with all three readers updated (grepped from the diff: constant, loop, and the three test rows are all `-` lines; no survivor).
- The sweep summary line renders BOTH window outcomes — `(horizon reached: a delivery inside the window was seen, not merely the first N rows)` vs `⛔ TRUNCATED at the …-page quota ceiling BEFORE reaching that horizon` — which is precisely the inversion this card is about, and both directions are self-tested (:13191–13195 of the new file).
- H39's one rule holds in the render: `≥N (PAGE CAP at … — ⛔ NOT a count)`, both directions tested.
- H38's predicate reuses `latestClaimComment` and intersects lanes locally — consistent with this seat's own 2026-08-31 measurement that `list_issues` label filters behave as OR on this build.

Premise adjudications accepted as reported, including both corrections to the filing cards' own numbers (this card's ~196/day was an update-rate mis-derivation; the stranding evidence stands and the time-cap repair is right regardless) and the #13574 supersession handling (drop own duplicate, merge main, keep theirs — correct under the in-flight overlap rule).

Landing: ready + auto-merge next stroke; the PR body's three Fixes lines retire the whole fold on merge, and this seat strips `pm:dispatched` from all three cards at close. Handed-back findings: the census decision card and the sibling-windows card are being filed now; H24's 12 pre-existing firings go to the next triage sweep; #11036 stays open and untouched by the fence, as reported.
